description: Run your nonprofit's fundraising from workflows: look up and update contacts, create and edit campaigns and funds, read donations, and start a workflow when a new contact or donation arrives.

givebutter_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs when a contact is added to Givebutter, by a donation, an import, the dashboard or the API, with their name, email, phone and tags. Contacts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.contact_since: The date the contact was added
output.email_opt_in: Whether they agreed to receive email
output.id: The contact's id, for Get, Update or Archive contact

givebutter_new_donation_trigger.description: Runs when a donation or payment succeeds in Givebutter, with the amount, the donor, the campaign and how it was paid. Donations already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.campaign_id: The campaign it was given to
output.donated: The amount that counts as the gift
output.id: The transaction's id, for Get transaction
output.is_recurring: Whether it is part of a recurring plan
output.method: How it was paid, such as card, check or cash
